guide.title: Interventions
guide.summary: Conditional protocols for investigation and remediation, with evaluation and rollback.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Interventions are independent entries. A diagnosis links to a protocol with an applicability condition. One protocol may eventually be relevant to several diagnoses.

ul.li: I001 — Preserve task-relevant evidence: an unvalidated protocol for testing a suspected loss of evidence from active context.

section.p: An intervention can be both an investigation and a potential remedy. Success on the task does not by itself prove a mechanism. Read the structure proposal before adding protocols.
